content:
elaine: Heads up — prepping release notes + internal announce for 1.14.0. Cutting tomorrow 22:00 PT. Need: 1) short internal blurb (1-2 lines) 2) pin owners for the blast 3) rollback criteria. @sam can you own the pin and deploybot cues?
sam: yep I can take pin + deploybot monitor. what's rollback threshold? 5% error rate? or latency p95 > 1s?
elaine: Good q. Ops proposed: revert if 10% increase in 5xx over baseline OR latency p95 +200ms sustained 10m. Also automatic fallback to 1.13.2 on capacity issues.
deploybot: Deploy scheduled: 1.14.0 -> production at 2025-11-16T22:00:00Z by deploybot. Canary rollout 10% for 15m, then 50% 20m, then full. Auto-rollback enabled on fail percent >=10.
maria: I drafted a 2-line internal blurb: "We’re shipping 1.14.0 tomorrow 22:00 PT — performance fixes for batching and minor UI copy tweaks. Pin owners: @sam (ops), @ryan (eng), @jess (docs). Expect short brief at T-1h." Thoughts?
ryan: lgtm but add 'no DB schema changes' to blurb to calm SRE.
jess: I can take microcopy mention in RN and update console screenshots post-cut. ETA 2h.
sam: I'll add deploybot playbook snippet: `deploybot rollback if request_5xx_rate > baseline*1.1 for 10m or p95_latency > baseline + 200ms for 10m`
elaine: Nice. Also need legal to sign off on data retention line — @maria can you ping legal?
maria: pinged legal via DM, they said quick review, will respond by EOD.
oncall-bot: reminder: oncall rotation for release window: @oncall_team_standby (ryan) & @oncall_team_secondary (liu). Escalation: page + SMS.
ryan: I'm standby for 22:00 PT and will watch canary dashboards. If we see the latency bump, I'll coordinate rollback with @sam.
jess: RN bullets below — please approve or suggest edits: `- perf: smarter batching for small prompts (up to 25% cost reduction)
- infra: dispatcher memory leak fix
- docs: updated console copy for model pinning`
sam: approve. Add note under ops: 'pin 1.14.0 to canary route for 2 hours before full ramp.'
elaine: ok locking: internal blurb set -> use maria's 2-line with the 'no DB schema changes' edit. pin owners: @sam @ryan @jess. I'll post internal announce at T-1h. Final checks: deploybot playbook attached, legal pending. thanks team :thumbsup:
